step_by_step_reasoning:
1. External users/internet traffic represented by the stick figure and cloud icon with IP whitelist ('x.x.x.x') connects to the Network Load Balancer (NLB).
2. The NLB distributes traffic to an Auto Scaling Group of EC2 instances running HAProxy ('HAProxy 10K!!') for SSL termination.
3. The HAProxy layer routes the decrypted TCP traffic to a Classic Load Balancer ('ELB') configured in TCP mode.
4. The ELB forwards traffic to the application EC2 instances ('App EC2').
5. The application tier connects to the database layer consisting of two Amazon RDS instances configured in a master-slave topology.
